objective.question: Do universal canonical SwiGLU Lloyd-4 labels contain held-out nonlocal structure beyond the strongest charged factorized public-context model?

scope.primary_stream_A: raw checkpoint weights -> canonical micro-neuron order -> public-block RMS normalization -> fixed Gaussian Lloyd-4 labels -> ordered Gray bitplanes
scope.arbitrary_shape_rule: Gate and Up semantic [d_ff,d_model], Down semantic [d_model,d_ff], with any positive integers d_ff and d_model
scope.diagnostic_only: Raw Lloyd labels omit reconstruction levels/scales and therefore are not a complete 2.15-2.5 bpw weight codec.
scope.deferred_stream_B: Deferred: current STRATA transformed indices/bitplanes require a separately authenticated extractor, byte-exact current-stream replay, and independently full-encoded Gaussian controls. They are not in the v1 launch surface.

allowed: clipped distance to public reset boundary
universal_decoder_context.identity_metadata_use: Layer/expert strings are split and reporting metadata only and never index a probability.

candidate_bank.state_update: O(1) exact integer and unifilar for every cell
candidate_bank.baseline: Factorized chi=1 model independently selects reset on validation.
candidate_bank.claim_boundary: A miss closes only this finite topology/context/reset bank; it does not close arbitrary MPS, TTN, MERA, learned transforms, or site-specific models.

probability_and_code.fit: Jeffreys-smoothed counts rounded by integer arithmetic to uint16 f1 in [1,65535]
probability_and_code.normalization: f0=65536-f1 exactly; no float is used by the probability decoder
probability_and_code.model_packet: 256-byte header plus dense context-by-state uint16 f1 table; topology successor rule is universal
probability_and_code.physical_code: 32-bit finite binary arithmetic coder with literal termination and final-byte padding
probability_and_code.verification: Every outer-test frame must decode exactly to the original labels from only model bytes and the public role/plane schedule.

nested_protocol.outer_test: Deterministic hash-ranked whole layers; no test layer enters fit or selection.
nested_protocol.inner_validation: Deterministic hash-ranked whole expert slots among non-test layers; no validation expert enters training.
nested_protocol.slot_universe: Exactly one stream per layer/slot and one identical reusable expert-slot universe across every layer are mandatory; irregular or layer-unique slot panels fail closed.
nested_protocol.selection: Actual validation container bytes including the complete model, headers, directory, frame termination, byte/page alignment; deterministic tie break.
nested_protocol.refit: After topology selection, refit only that topology on train plus validation and score untouched whole-layer test.

physical_ledger.cold_read: Literal union of container-header pages, all selected-model pages, the addressed directory-entry page, and exact pages intersecting the expert frame.
physical_ledger.per_expert_denominator: B_shared/E + B_private_i, where B_shared includes the container header, model pages, directory pages, and final page padding; denominators sum exactly to the physical container.

controls.raw_A_pipeline: Independently sample Gaussian weights matched to each source public normalization block's mean and variance, then independently repeat canonicalization, normalization, Lloyd labeling, nested selection, refit, arithmetic coding, and all charges.
controls.accepted_input: The control evaluator accepts the immutable raw SwiGLU panel only; arbitrary prebuilt SymbolStream control panels are forbidden.
controls.provenance_binding: Every seed is bound to the source tensor, source geometry, exact binary64 block moments, generated Gaussian tensor, generated label panel, candidate bank, and complete nested selection/fitting/packing result hashes.
controls.no_control_created_pass: Control subtraction may characterize Qwen-specific excess but can never turn an absolute source miss into survival.

promotion.primary: The paired whole-test-layer 95% lower bound on net physical saving versus the independently validation-selected factorized model must exceed 0.1528899669629145 bpw before controls.
promotion.confidence: 4096-replicate deterministic paired whole-test-layer percentile cluster bootstrap with at least five independent whole-layer clusters; selected/factorized paired byte deltas are resampled together and shared-byte delta is allocated by source weights with exact total closure.
promotion.universality: A positive Qwen result is one evaluation, not a universal claim; promotion requires at least one independently sourced different SwiGLU-MoE family with the frozen algorithm.
promotion.next_stage: Only a survivor earns integration with an unchanged finite 2.15-2.5 bpw reconstruction and one end-to-end byte/read ledger.

order: reserve absent output and write INCOMPLETE state
authenticate independent source-review receipt including exact entrypoint bytes
import CuPy for future GPU work
lifecycle.future_payload_bootstrap: A future payload runner must be authenticated and executed by an independently pinned bootstrap outside the producer package; a public token, self-seal, or producer-authored receipt is not authority.
